notes:
T637 — the complementarity reduction (ruling 34's second half). Built tools/complementarity.py, the reduction from race artifacts to the standing complementarity record, and ran it on the two first real inputs (Race F graded by T632, Race A's five audits). All four brief controls pass; regression wired into `zig build test` (tools/regression-complementarity.sh, build.zig). Full numbers: tools/complementarity-record.json (generated from tools/complementarity-inputs/race-a.json + race-f.json; byte-identical across runs).

SCHEMA (the interface T636 reads; also `python3 tools/complementarity.py schema`): input race files (schema==race-input, schema_version 1) carry a graded reference union with verdicts (real/false/uncertain), lanes with optional cost, and either explicit finding->item mappings (form A, raw audits) or direct caught_by per item (form B, graded races). Output groups by task_type/epoch: n (real items only), per-lane catches/unique-catch rates, pairwise overlap matrix (Jaccard + shared), best-subset-of-size-k coverage table, caught_matrix (raw, for T636-style marginals), merges (counts + policy), false_raises census, uncaught_items (absorption path), and a prior_warning/sample_note labelling numbers from one race as a prior.

DEFINITIONAL CHOICE (the controls pin it): the brief's parenthetical 'findings that model alone caught, over the union' and its control 1 (disjoint lanes -> both rates 1.0) contradict — over a 4-item union split 2/2 the union-denominator rate is 0.5 for both. The controls are the executable spec, so unique_catch_rate = |unique| / |own catches| (disjoint -> 1.0), and the literal union-denominator reading is ALSO reported as unique_catch_over_union. Both definitions are in rate_definitions and in the record.

HONESTY MECHANICS: (1) every group and the header repeat the disclaimer 'coverage of the union we found, never of the truth'; (2) unique-catch rate and cost are separate numbers, never blended — costs from the dispatch-time token ledger (untracked/tokens/tokens.jsonl), stated unknown where the ledger has no clean reading (deepseek lanes, api-error entries) rather than estimated; (3) merges are counted mechanically from explicit mappings (form A) or declared-upstream (form B), with the policy stated; the tool refuses an unmapped finding instead of silently dropping it; (4) n is stated per group (26 real items; 5 adjudicated-false and 1 uncertain excluded and reported), and single-race groups are labelled a prior.

FIRST-RUN RESULTS, n=26 (the graded reference union is T632's canonical_items, so both races reduce against the same union):
- spec-audit/2026-08-22 (Race A, five auditors): opus (lane-3) 17/26 catches, 10 unique, within-lane rate 0.588; dsflash (lane-1) 9/26, 4 unique, 0.444; fable (lane-5) 8/26, 3 unique, 0.375; haiku (lane-4) 4/26, 1 unique, 0.25; sonnet (lane-2) 3/26, 0 unique. Best subsets: k=1 {opus} 0.654; k=2 {opus,dsflash} and {opus,fable} 0.808; k=3 {opus,dsflash,fable} 0.962; k=4 1.0; k=5 1.0. 18 items were caught by exactly one auditor (genuine complementarity; the best pair covers 21/26). Merge decisions made by this reduction: 36 raw findings -> 50 mappings, 18 merges, 10 splits (list in the input file). False/uncertain raises (cost side): lane-1 {A5, G1}, lane-3 {F5, G1, G2}, lane-4 {G3, G4}.
- adjudication/2026-08-22 (Race F, five entrants): one entrant alone covers the full union — k=1 coverage 1.0 for entrants 2/3/4 (opus, dsflash, fable), and every entrant's unique-catch count is 0 (entrants 2/3/4 caught all 26; entrant-1 missed A2/D2/F4/H1, entrant-5 missed C2/F3). Overlap Jaccard between the top entrants is 1.0. Five seats were over-provisioned for union coverage; the adjudication-quality axis T632 graded is a separate dimension this record does not measure, stated as such. Merge decisions by this reduction: 0 (form B; T632's grader documented the dedup in its reference_union prose — cited in the input notes).

MERGE-DECISION PROVENANCE: Race A's mappings are my transcription of the five audits against T632's canonical items, reusing T632's documented dedup rule (same defect + same fix target = one finding). Race F's caught sets are transcribed from T632's union_recall.per_entrant counts (entrant-1 22/26, entrant-2 26/26, entrant-3 26/26, entrant-4 26/26, entrant-5 24/26). Lane->model attribution read from the sealed keys (untracked/race-grading/race-f/KEY.json, race-f-grade/KEY.json); all sha256s verified against disk (T632's grading seat was told not to read the key; this reduction is over already-graded data and the record is per-model by design, so the key was read and every source hash cross-checked).

CONTROLS (all pass, `python3 tools/complementarity.py check`): (1) seeded disjoint -> overlap 0, both unique_catch_rate 1.0, best-subset-of-2 reaches the union; (2) seeded subset (B subset of A, third lane C) -> B rate 0, {A,B} not picked; (3) single-lane race -> overlap_matrix null with an explicit note, never a 1x1 matrix of 1.0; (4) same race fed twice -> byte-identical output (no clock, no randomness). Plus out-of-process determinism on the committed real inputs, pinned by the regression script.
